_comment: Approved training-data mentions not published because a required public source is unresolved.

items.reason: The original BooksCorpus is no longer officially distributed. Unofficial mirrors and BookCorpusOpen are not the same release and were not substituted.

The TextFooler paper records this exact Kaggle competition for training, but both its legacy and current competition data routes now return 404. Other similarly named fake-news datasets are different releases and were not substituted.

The original ShareGPT service is deprecated and does not provide an authoritative, versioned training-corpus download. Common HF/GitHub copies are third-party snapshots with differing filters, so none is assigned as canonical.
